knowledgeBases.title: Knowledge Bases
knowledgeBases.description: Managed documents for retrieval, reranking, and validated citations.
knowledgeBases.createDescription: Chunking and retrieval use Godar's versioned profile.

empty.title: No knowledge bases yet
empty.description: Create a knowledge base and add a valid file or manual text.

documents.title: Documents in {name}
documents.description: Only versions in the ready state are available to retrieval.
documents.addDescription: Complete either the manual text fields or choose one file.
documents.textHint: For manual text, provide both title and text.
documents.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, or HTML up to 25 MB. Persian-capable OCR runs automatically for scanned PDFs.

empty.title: No documents in this knowledge base
empty.description: Add a supported file or manual text.

chatbots.title: Chatbot Builder
chatbots.description: Publish grounded chatbots with retrieval, mandatory reranking, and validated citations.
chatbots.createDescription: Bots default to private and every publication creates an immutable snapshot.
chatbots.selectKB: Select at least one ready knowledge base.
chatbots.kbHint: Up to five knowledge bases; a base without ready documents cannot be published.
chatbots.modelHint: The exact allowed tenant model or virtual model revision is pinned.
chatbots.instructionHint: Document content remains untrusted data and cannot override this instruction.
chatbots.originsHint: For a public widget, enter one allowed origin per line.

empty.title: No chatbots yet
empty.description: Once a knowledge base is ready, create a private or public chatbot.

chat.title: Test chatbot
chat.pageDescription: Test grounded answers, citations, and refusal behavior for a published chatbot.
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about the connected knowledge base…
chat.inputHint: Enter to send; Shift+Enter for a new line

empty.title: Start the conversation
empty.description: Ask a question related to the documents connected to this chatbot.

unpublished.title: Chatbot is not published
unpublished.description: Publish the chatbot from the builder before testing its runtime.

openWebUI.title: Open WebUI connection
openWebUI.description: This base URL implements OpenAI Chat Completions compatibility.
openWebUI.privateHint: For this private bot, use a short-lived session token as the API key.
openWebUI.publicHint: For a public bot, enter any placeholder such as public in the API key field.
openWebUI.tokenWarning: This value is shown only once. Enter it as the API key in Open WebUI.
openWebUI.tokenError: Unable to create the temporary API key.

analytics.title: Analytics for {name}
analytics.description: Content-free aggregate quality and usage metrics.

errors.load: Unable to load managed RAG data.
errors.chat: The chatbot could not answer right now. Check the RAG provider configuration and try again.
